organization.name_ja: クリプトン・フューチャー・メディア株式会社

affected.note: Sum of the categories in the 2026-10-22 update: 362,137 SONICWIRE members, 671 invoice, receipt and quote records entered up to 2021-11-19, and 11 newsletter-only subscribers. The 2026-10-19 notice gave a preliminary maximum of about 420,000. D2R store data was also affected but no count was given. No card data is stored and license serial numbers were not taken.

summary.en: Crypton Future Media detected possible unauthorized access to the servers of its SONICWIRE and D2R services on the evening of 2026-10-17 and shut them down. In an update on 2026-10-22 it confirmed that data had been viewed and taken, including names, email addresses and salted password hashes of 362,137 SONICWIRE members.
summary.ja: クリプトン・フューチャー・メディアは2026年10月17日夜、「SONICWIRE」と「D2R」のサーバーへの不正アクセスの可能性を検知し、サーバーを停止した。10月22日の更新で、SONICWIRE会員362,137件の氏名、メールアドレス、ソルト付きハッシュ化パスワードなどが閲覧・取得されたことを確認したと発表した。
